description: Hold a place in the line at Voss Avenue, then carry the ticket down to Cinder Lane for someone who matters more than you. 15₵.
name: Hold a Place

emotes: {who} plants both feet at Voss Avenue and glares at anyone who even thinks about cutting the line.
{who} leans against the gate, arms crossed, holding the spot like it's sacred ground.
{who} shuffles forward an inch and calls it progress.
{who} hustles the ticket over to Cinder Lane, muttering the number over and over so it doesn't slip their mind.
{who} jogs the ticket toward Cinder Lane, checking it hasn't smudged.
{who} waves the ticket like it's a passport to somewhere important.
